all_elements_established.text: The judge found every condition this provision requires in words quoted from your facts, and found no fact that defeats the claim.

denial_established.text: The judge found a fact in your case that defeats this claim, and quoted it.

missing_element.text: The judge did not find at least one required condition shown in your facts.

no_training_statute_text.text: We have no statute text for this provision, so we did not judge it.

judge_error.text: A judge call failed on at least one condition, so we give no answer.

assembly_lean_mismatch.text: Two internal checks disagreed, so we give no answer.

denial_unquotable.text: The judge thinks a defeating fact exists but could not give a valid word-for-word quote for it. Please have a lawyer look.

second_judge_defeater_disagreement.text: The two judges disagree on whether a defeating fact exists. Please have a lawyer look.

uncertain.text: The judge is not sure whether a condition holds. Please have a lawyer look.

uncertain_second_judge.text: The second judge is not sure whether a condition holds. Please have a lawyer look.

second_judge_unavailable.text: The second judge was unavailable, so we give a referral, not an answer.

gate1_unavailable.text: The entailment check (a separate check of the quoted words against the claim) was unavailable, so we give a referral, not an answer.

gate1_not_entailed.text: The entailment check (a separate check of the quoted words against the claim) did not find enough support for it. Please have a lawyer look.

gate1_contradiction.text: The entailment check (a separate check of the quoted words against the claim) found they contradict it. Please have a lawyer look.

contract_not_validated.text: This provision is not on the validated list, so we give a referral, not a proof or denial.

quote_check.ok: The judge's quoted words appear exactly once in the fact they name.
quote_check.not_established: The judge did not find this condition shown in your facts.
quote_check.no_quote: The judge said this condition holds but gave no words to show it.
quote_check.unknown_fact: The judge pointed to a fact that is not among yours.
quote_check.non_evidential_quote: The judge's quote was too short or only punctuation to count as evidence.
quote_check.quote_not_found: The judge's quote does not appear word for word (same capital letters and spacing) in the fact it named.
quote_check.ambiguous_quote: The judge's quote appears more than once in that fact, so we cannot tell which passage it meant. The condition is not counted as shown.
